agent_comment: The variable records the recruiting centre, i.e. the study site; rejected NCIT:C83081 Study Site Identifier because the description names the centre, not an identifier code.
note: Agent error, identifier versus entity: chose the facility, but the column holds codes naming it.

agent_comment: NCIT Age at Diagnosis is generic (defined for initial pathologic diagnosis), so it is broader than age at PD diagnosis; no PD-specific or clinical-diagnosis age term was found.
note: Agent error, over-literal definition: read the disease named in the variable as narrowing the concept.

agent_comment: A clinician-judged diagnosis of depression is a disease diagnosis, so MONDO depressive disorder is used; rejected HP:0000716 Depression (symptom) and MONDO:0002009 major depressive disorder (narrower).
note: Agent error, guideline ambiguity: read a clinician-judged condition as a diagnosis (MONDO) instead of a phenotype (HPO). Review kept MONDO as a related mapping.

agent_comment: No LOINC code exists for an alpha-synuclein seed amplification assay result in CSF, so the analyte alpha-synuclein is related; rejected LOINC:49456-7, which is immunostaining in tissue.
note: Gold-standard error: review accepted the agent's mapping (the analyte rule applies, as for V048).

agent_comment: Maximum ThT fluorescence (RFU) of the alpha-synuclein SAA is a relative-unit readout with no LOINC code, so it is related only to the analyte; rejected any concentration test and NCIT:C218853 Thioflavin T (the dye).
note: Gold-standard error: review accepted the agent's mapping (the analyte rule applies, as for V048).

agent_comment: Fasted more than 8 h before the blood draw (y/n) is the fasting status at specimen collection; rejected NCIT:C93566 Fasting Status Indicator and NCIT:C120460 Fasting Status as less specific to the draw.
note: Gold-standard error: review accepted the agent's more specific term.

agent_comment: The assay plate or batch identifier matches NCIT Assay Plate Identifier; rejected NCIT:C104504 Batch Number, a manufacturing lot.
note: Gold-standard error: the gold standard missed an existing NCIT term.

agent_comment: No NCIT term exists for levodopa equivalent daily dose, so the general Daily Dose is broader; rejected NCIT:C611 Levodopa because LEDD sums all antiparkinsonian drugs.
